integrity: Self-contained mathematical proof and reproducible binary tests supplied. No independent assessment or validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: The arbitrary-base theorem applies only when the adjacency is nilpotent over characteristic two. Generic Kronecker-sum Jordan theory and second-order reversible constructions are established; novelty concerns their matched-prism dynamical synthesis and exact clock transfer. Full texts of Macfarlane 2004 and Norman 2008 were unavailable, leaving a stated priority risk. Finite checks cannot establish an infinite theorem.
title: A three-halves clock law for reversible waves on nilpotent-base graph prisms
